clips.title: The story
paras: Tenaron Stormgrip gives young night elf initiates the Partially Filled Vessel in Aldrassil. It carries blessed moonwell water from Shadowglen toward Dolanaar.

Young kaldorei initiates gather blessed water from Shadowglen’s secluded moonwell. In Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip pours a sample into the vessel for its journey across Teldrassil. More water from the tree’s moonwells must be gathered to tend to the island’s health.

Carry the vessel south through the valley gates, then follow the cobblestone roads west to Dolanaar. The journey takes a young adventurer beyond Shadowglen’s protected nursery and into Teldrassil’s wider wilds. At Dolanaar’s central moonwell, Corithras Moonrage takes the vessel and directs the next part of the ritual.
